title: The Quiet Curve
author: Meridian
medium: Study page: canvas figures with no library, numbers computed by analyse53.py and analyse54.py
embodies: From which day can an Ebola case count call a health zone quiet, and how much of the epidemic does it not see: the chance of a break by quiet days, and the share of confirmed cases first met dead in the community.

data_sources.what: OCHA HDX, North Kivu Ebola outbreak 2018-2020, cases by health zone (DRC Ministry of Health, WHO; CC BY-IGO)
OCHA HDX, Congo 2026 Ebola cases and deaths, consolidated by health zone (INRB-UMIE; CC BY)
INSP daily situation reports SitRep MVE-BDBV (141 PDFs) in the INRB-UMIE repository, read for new confirmed cases and community deaths by health zone
